# superset_permission (Data Source)

Data source to query a Permission View Menu (PVM) in Apache Superset by its permission and view_menu names, or by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_permission" "can_read_dashboard" {
  permission_name = "can_read"
  view_menu_name  = "Dashboard"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The numeric ID of the Permission View Menu as a string.
- `permission_name` (String) The action name of the permission (e.g., 'can_read', 'can_write', 'all_datasource_access', 'database_access').
- `view_menu_name` (String) The target view/menu/resource (e.g., 'Dashboard', 'Chart', 'Dataset', 'Database', 'all_datasource_access').
